narrative: Scout sharpens the prediction's structural force: rather than rebuild the agent loop, Microsoft adopts the open OpenClaw harness as Scout's runtime and competes on a governance wrapper of scoped Entra identity, audit trails, policy-conformance checks, and Purview enforcement, the convergence logic where differentiated work moves to the wrapper. But that wrapper is identity and governance, not the named containment posture.
remaining_gap: A peer vendor publishing a named containment profile (gVisor at the cloud tier, OS sandboxes at the laptop tier) and a standards-body agent-runtime-containment draft.
